title: Product Delivery Manager - ServiceNow - Now Assist-HRSD
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-ServiceNow – Supervising Associate (Product Delivery Manager – Now Assist & HRSD)**
**Role Overview:**
The ServiceNow Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of one or more ServiceNow technology solutions within EY. The role ensures that solutions are aligned with the overall EY ServiceNow strategy, integrate effectively within the enterprise technology ecosystem, and consistently deliver high-quality business outcomes.
  
  
As the primary representative and advocate of ET ServiceNow, the Product Delivery Manager is accountable for the success of assigned products and services. This includes ownership of product planning, roadmap development, backlog prioritization, stakeholder engagement, and delivery oversight throughout the product lifecycle. The Product Delivery Manager is accountable for evaluating emerging ServiceNow capabilities, aligning them with business objectives, driving stakeholder awareness and adoption through demonstrations and consultations, and establishing a prioritized roadmap and implementation backlog to maximize platform value.
  
  
The role of Product Delivery Manager is responsible for the end-to-end management and delivery of ServiceNow solutions focusing on HR Service Delivery as well as Now Assist capabilities (including AI agents, agentic workflows and now assist skills). In addition, this role would lead implementations to make ServiceNow as an orchestrator to call multiple AI agents within and outside of ServiceNow using Model Context Protocol (MCP) or Agent-to-Agent protocol (A2A) to allow ServiceNow agents to invoke external data sets and APIs.
  
  
The Product Delivery Manager ensures that solutions are delivered in accordance with governance standards, within agreed timelines and budgets, and meet quality, security, and user experience expectation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Product Strategy & Lifecycle Management:**

* Ensure products align with the EY ServiceNow strategy and broader enterprise technology objectives.
* Evaluate new ServiceNow platform capabilities and features, assess business value, and drive adoption opportunities.
* Develop and maintain the product implementation backlog based on business priorities and platform capabilities.

**Stakeholder Management:**

* Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor between ET ServiceNow and business stakeholders.
* Collaborate with business teams to understand requirements, challenges, and strategic objectives.
* Translate business needs into scalable ServiceNow solutions while promoting platform best practices and standardization.
* Work with multiple stakeholders/ vendors to clear business/ technical impediments/ blockers

**Product backlog and Planning:**

* Own and govern the product backlog, ensuring alignment with business priorities and strategic goals
* Work closely with Product Owners to define, prioritize, and refine features, enhancements, and technical requirements
* Balance business demands with platform capabilities, technical constraints, and long-term solution sustainability (strong functional understanding of ServiceNow is a must. Development experience expected).

**Delivery Management:**

* Successfully execute the project to agreed schedule, budget and scope
* Manage the demand process
* Monitor risks, dependencies, and delivery milestones, implementing mitigation plans as required.
* Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including architecture, development, testing, operations, and vendors.
* Coordinate UAT and production go-live

**Governance and Continuous improvement:**

* Establish and maintain governance processes for product performance, quality, and compliance.
* Track product KPIs, adoption metrics, and customer satisfaction measures.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to optimize business processes and maximize platform value.

**Innovation and Platform enablement:**

* Stay current with ServiceNow roadmap developments and emerging platform capabilities.
* Demonstrate new features and innovations to business stakeholders and leadership teams.
* Identify opportunities to improve user experience, operational efficiency, and business outcomes through ServiceNow.

**Knowledge and Skills Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field
* 3+ years of hands-on experience in ServiceNow development.
* Understanding of ITIL processes and HR Services
* Understanding of conversational experiences, virtual agents, knowledge management, and self-service adoption strategies.
* Implementation expertise of Now Assist capabilities (out of box and custom skills), agentic workflow and AI agents
* Experience in configuring out of box agentic workflows and implementing custom AI agents
* Understanding of A2A and MCP protocols
* Deep functional knowledge of LLMs, agentic patterns and API integration paths (REST)
* Advanced comprehension of agile SAFe project management methodology, tools and templates (includes project planning, schedule development, scope management and cost management)
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills
* ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA) certification

**What are we looking for?**

* A team player and leader with strong technical acumen and leadership capabilities
* Proactive problem-solving mindset with a focus on operational excellence
* Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities in a fast-paced environment
* Passion to learn and adapt to new technologies
* Strong functional/ technical understanding of HRSD and ITSM applications.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: GDS Cyber - Frontier AI Layered Defense - Senior Manager
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Title: EY – Frontier AI Security Lead / Layered Defence Lead – Technology Consulting – Senior Manager**
**About the Role:**
EY is seeking a Senior Manager – Frontier AI Security Lead / Layered Defence Lead to shape, scale, and lead the firm’s capabilities for securing frontier AI systems, generative AI platforms, LLM-powered applications, and agentic or multi-agent architectures. The role will focus on enabling trusted enterprise adoption of advanced AI by designing layered defence strategies that address risks across governance, data, model, agent, application, identity, runtime, and infrastructure layers.
  
  
This leader will define AI security strategy, reference architectures, control patterns, and delivery methodologies that help clients manage emerging risks such as prompt injection, indirect prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage, model and RAG poisoning, excessive agency, autonomous tool misuse, system prompt exposure, AI supply chain compromise, and unsafe model or agent behaviour.
  
  
The successful candidate will serve as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders and internal leadership, translating frontier AI risk into actionable security programmes, scalable managed capabilities, and market-relevant offerings. The role will also contribute to go-to-market strategy, sales pursuits, solution shaping, and the growth of EY’s AI Security practice.
  
  
The ideal candidate will combine deep cybersecurity, AI, cloud, architecture, and consulting experience with the ability to lead multidisciplinary teams, influence senior stakeholders, and build differentiated capabilities for securing AI at enterprise scale.
  
  
**Layered Defence Scope:**
The role will establish and mature layered defence patterns across the following AI security domains: governance and policy; data, knowledge, and retrieval pipelines; model access and prompt controls; agent planning, memory, tool use, and orchestration; application, API, and integration security; identity, access, secrets, and permissioning; runtime monitoring, telemetry, detection, and response; cloud, platform, infrastructure, and AI supply chain security.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Strategy and Practice Leadership**

* Define and drive EY’s Frontier AI Security and Layered Defence strategy across client and enterprise environments.
* Build and scale AI security offerings, delivery methods, reusable assets, accelerators, reference architectures, and control frameworks.
* Lead go-to-market development, sales pursuits, RFP responses, proposals, solution shaping, and commercial growth for AI security engagements.
* Establish a strong AI Security capability and community of practice, including talent development, enablement, knowledge sharing, and innovation priorities.

**Frontier AI Security Architecture**

* Architect secure AI systems across LLM applications, RAG pipelines, AI agents, multi-agent systems, model integrations, APIs, and enterprise platforms.
* Define defence-in-depth patterns across data, model, prompt, agent, application, identity, runtime, and infrastructure layers.
* Embed security into AI engineering lifecycles, including design reviews, threat modelling, secure build standards, MLOps, GenAIOps, DevSecOps, testing, deployment, and continuous monitoring.
* Advise clients on secure adoption of frontier AI capabilities, including high-risk use cases, autonomous workflows, and AI-enabled decision support.

**AI Risk, Red Teaming, and Control Design**

* Lead AI threat modelling and risk assessments for frontier AI use cases, including LLMs, agentic workflows, RAG systems, model providers, and third-party AI components.
* Establish AI red teaming and adversarial testing approaches covering prompt injection, jailbreaks, data exfiltration, model manipulation, tool abuse, excessive agency, and unsafe agent behaviour.
* Define and implement guardrails, policy enforcement, input and output validation, content safety controls, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, permission boundaries, and runtime response mechanisms.
* Align AI security controls to recognised industry frameworks and emerging regulatory expectations, including AI governance, privacy, cybersecurity, and responsible AI requirements.

**Client Advisory and Delivery Leadership**

* Lead large-scale client engagements and advise CxOs, technology leaders, cyber leaders, and risk stakeholders on AI security strategy and operating models.
* Translate complex AI security risks into board-ready narratives, practical control roadmaps, investment priorities, and measurable transformation outcomes.
* Build trusted relationships with clients, partners, ecosystem providers, and internal stakeholders to drive collaboration and business growth.
* Mentor high-performing teams and foster a culture of innovation, automation, responsible AI adoption, and continuous learning.

**Technical Skills and Expertise:**

* Deep expertise in AI security, cybersecurity architecture, cloud security, application security, data protection, privacy, identity, and incident response.
* Strong understanding of frontier AI systems, LLMs, multimodal models, RAG, vector databases, agentic AI, multi-agent orchestration, model context protocols, and AI-enabled automation workflows.

**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced  Solution Architect - AI with 10+ years of overall technology experience, including at least 3 years of hands-on experience designing and architecting AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, or Agentic AI solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in enterprise solution architecture and experience designing scalable, secure, resilient, and production-ready AI solutions on at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  
  
The role will be responsible for defining end-to-end AI solution architectures covering application, data, AI/ML, integration, security, infrastructure, and operational components. The architect will work closely with business stakeholders, enterprise architects, data teams, AI engineers, software engineers, security teams, and cloud platform teams to translate business requirements into practical and scalable technology solutions.
  
  
The candidate should have strong knowledge of modern AI architecture patterns including Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI, AI agents, vector databases, knowledge retrieval, API/tool integration, model orchestration, observability, security, and responsible AI. Experience in taking AI solutions from initial discovery and proof-of-concept through production deployment and operationalization is essential.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Design end-to-end AI and Generative AI solution architectures that address business requirements while meeting enterprise standards for scalability, security, performance, reliability, and maintainability.
* Define appropriate architecture patterns for Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG, Machine Learning, intelligent automation, conversational AI, and AI-enabled enterprise applications.
* Provide architectural leadership across the complete solution lifecycle, from discovery, feasibility assessment, architecture definition, prototyping, implementation, production deployment, and post-production operations.
* Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to evaluate AI use cases, identify suitable technologies, assess technical feasibility, and define implementation roadmaps.
* Lead the architecture and solution design of enterprise AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Agentic AI solutions across cloud and hybrid environments.
* Translate business requirements, functional requirements, and non-functional requirements into scalable and secure solution architecture designs, architecture diagrams, integration patterns, and technical specifications.
* Design AI solutions using services and technologies available on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, including managed AI/ML, data, integration, compute, security, and observability services.
* Define architectures for LLM-based applications, including prompt orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector search, embeddings, model routing, grounding, knowledge bases, AI agents, tool/function calling, and multi-agent architectures.
* Design enterprise integration patterns connecting AI solutions with APIs, databases, data platforms, SaaS applications, enterprise applications, event-driven systems, and external services.
* Evaluate and recommend appropriate foundation models, LLMs, embedding models, AI platforms, vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and supporting technologies based on business, technical, security, cost, and performance requirements.
* Define architecture approaches for AI security, identity and access management, data privacy, guardrails, content filtering, responsible AI, model governance, and regulatory compliance.
* Establish architectural standards for AI observability, monitoring, tracing, logging, evaluation, performance management, reliability, and operational support.
* Work closely with AI engineers, data scientists, data engineers, application developers, DevOps/MLOps teams, cloud engineers, and security teams to guide implementation and ensure alignment with the target architecture.
* Lead architecture reviews, technical design workshops, proof-of-concepts, technology assessments, and design governance activities while communicating complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and business stakeholders.
* Ability to conduct AI use-case discovery, technical feasibility assessments, architecture assessments, technology evaluations, and solution option analysis.
* Ability to create and communicate high-level architecture, detailed solution architecture, sequence diagrams, data flows, integration diagrams, deployment architectures, and architecture decision records.
* Ability to design appropriate AI guardrails addressing areas such as hallucination, prompt injection, data leakage, harmful content, unauthorized tool execution, and inappropriate model responses.
* Ability to define reference architectures, reusable architecture patterns, technical standards, and architecture governance frameworks for AI solutions.

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Senior AI Architect**
**Experience**

* 15+ years overall; 8+ years in Java/J2EE; 2+ years in AI/GenAI delivery

**Role focus**

* AI-led modernization of enterprise Java platforms and creation of scalable, secure AI solutions

**The opportunity**
We are seeking a Senior AI Architect who combines deep Java/J2EE architecture expertise with hands-on AI and Generative AI delivery experience. The role will shape AI-first enterprise solutions, embed intelligent capabilities into existing Java estates, and guide clients from experimentation through secure, production-scale adoption.
  
  
The successful candidate will operate at the intersection of enterprise architecture, product engineering, cloud-native modernization and applied AI. They will define target architectures, make technology decisions, lead engineering teams, and advise senior stakeholders on how AI can create measurable business and engineering outcomes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**AI and solution architecture**

* Define end-to-end architectures for AI-enabled enterprise applications, from data ingestion and retrieval through model orchestration, inference, APIs, user experience and production operations.
* Architect Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), semantic search, knowledge graph, multimodal and agentic AI solutions aligned to business workflows.
* Design multi-agent systems / skills, tool-use patterns and orchestration approaches, including Model Context Protocol (MCP) where relevant.
* Establish architecture blueprints, reusable patterns, non-functional requirements and technology guardrails for scalable, secure and responsible AI adoption.
* Evaluate models, frameworks, data stores and cloud AI services based on quality, latency, security, portability, operability and cost.

**Java/J2EE engineering and modernization**

* Architect enterprise solutions using Java/J2EE, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security and RESTful APIs.
* Integrate LLM-powered services, copilots and AI agents into existing Java applications and business workflows through well-governed APIs and event-driven patterns.
* Decompose monolithic applications into modular services and define modernization pathways that introduce AI without compromising business continuity.
* Design microservices, event-driven and distributed architectures using technologies such as Kafka or RabbitMQ, container platforms and API management.
* Guide engineering teams on code quality, design patterns, performance, resilience, observability, security and maintainability.

**Cloud, LLMOps and production engineering**

* Design and deploy AI solutions on Azure, AWS or GCP using appropriate managed AI services and cloud-native components.
* Establish CI/CD, DevSecOps, MLOps and LLMOps practices covering prompt, model and configuration versioning; automated testing; deployment; monitoring; evaluation and rollback.
* Define AI quality and evaluation frameworks for relevance, groundedness, safety, latency, reliability and cost.
* Implement observability across application, model and agent layers, and drive continuous improvement using telemetry and user feedback.
* Lead the transition from proof of concept to hardened, scalable production deployment.

**Governance, security and responsible AI**

* Embed privacy, data governance, access control, content safety, model security, auditability and Responsible AI requirements into solution design.
* Define controls for prompt injection, sensitive-data exposure, unsafe outputs, model misuse and third-party model risk.
* Partner with security, risk, legal and compliance stakeholders to align AI solutions with enterprise policies and applicable regulatory obligations.
* Drive cost transparency and FinOps practices for model usage, infrastructure and multi-cloud AI workloads.

**Consulting, leadership and capability building**

* Lead discovery workshops, architecture assessments and design sessions with business and technology stakeholders.
* Translate business goals into AI roadmaps, solution options, implementation plans and clear value cases.
* Act as a trusted advisor to client leadership and communicate architecture choices, trade-offs, risks and outcomes in executive-ready language.
* Provide technical leadership for pursuits, proposals, solutioning and estimation, including architecture narratives and delivery models.
* Lead and mentor cross-functional teams of architects, Java engineers, AI engineers, data scientists and platform specialists.
* Create reusable accelerators, reference implementations, knowledge assets and engineering standards for the EAT competency.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* Education: BE/BTech/MCA or equivalent degree in computer science, engineering or a related discipline.
* Overall experience: 15+ years in software architecture, engineering and enterprise solution delivery.
* Java/J2EE depth: 8+ years designing and delivering enterprise-grade Java/J2EE applications, with strong Spring ecosystem experience.
* Architecture depth: 5+ years in microservices, distributed systems, API-led and event-driven architecture.
* AI delivery: 2+ years of hands-on architecture and implementation experience in AI/ML/GenAI initiatives, with evidence of production or enterprise-scale delivery.
* Leadership: Experience leading multidisciplinary engineering teams and owning architecture and delivery outcomes.
* Consulting: Strong client engagement, workshop facilitation, presales, storytelling and senior stakeholder communication skills.

**Mandatory Technical Skills**
**Capability & Expected proficiency**

* Enterprise engineering - Java 8/11/17+, J2EE, Spring Boot, Spring MVC, Spring Security, REST APIs, microservices, design patterns, distributed systems
* Integration and platforms - API management, Kafka/RabbitMQ, event-driven architecture, Docker, Kubernetes, service observability
* GenAI and agentic AI - LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, RAG, semantic and hybrid search, AI agents, multi-agent orchestration, context engineering
* AI frameworks - Hands-on exposure to relevant frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI or Haystack
* Data and retrieval - SQL/NoSQL, vector databases such as Azure AI Search, Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS or equivalent; knowledge graphs such as Neo4j

* Operationalization - CI/CD, DevSecOps, MLOps/LLMOps, model and prompt lifecycle, evaluation, monitoring, tracing and production support

* Develop models with Python using PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, scikit‑learn, and Hugging Face Transformers, package as reproducible services.

* Engineer scalable model serving with KServe, Seldon Core, BentoML, Ray Serve, NVIDIA Triton, supporting A/B, canary, shadow deployments.

* Design Python microservices using FastAPI/gRPC; integrate with downstream systems via REST/GraphQL; write robust automation in Python/Bash/PowerShell and SQL for data ops.
* Use notebooks (Jupyter) and packaging (Poetry/pip/conda) with virtualenvs, environment locking, and artifacts suitable for promotion across stages.

description:
**The Company**
CTeBS, a subsidiary of Classic Fashion, is a leading software solution provider to the apparel manufacturing industry globally. Our suite of enterprise-level products, including our flagship Trendz CMP, leverages cutting-edge technology to enhance productivity, quality, and efficiency, ensuring our clients achieve unparalleled growth and success. Our journey with Classic Fashion has uniquely positioned us to design technology-enabled products and solutions for the ever-evolving needs of the apparel manufacturing sector, and we are poised for an exciting phase of growth.
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are looking for a results-driven
**Technical Manager**
who effectively bridges the gap between high-level engineering strategy and day-to-day execution. In this role, you will lead a technical team not just by authority, but by technical competence and vision. You will be responsible for defining long-term technical goals, implementing robust development processes, and measuring team performance against concrete metrics.
  
  
You will be responsible for defining the technical vision, establishing robust development processes, and using data-driven metrics to optimize team performance. You must possess a strong background in
**Java, Angular, and SQL**
not to code, but to validate architectural decisions, challenge technical assumptions, and mentor your team leads.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Define and execute a long-term technical roadmap that aligns with business goals. Move the team from "reactive maintenance" to "proactive innovation."
* Own the SDLC. Move beyond basic Agile/Scrum participation to designing the process. Identify bottlenecks in the CI/CD pipeline, QA handoffs, or requirements gathering and fix them.
* Define, track, and report on engineering KPIs (e.g., Sprint Velocity, Cycle Time, Defect Removal Efficiency, Code Coverage). Use these metrics to predict delivery timelines and identify training needs.

title: Technical Program Head
description:

• Experience with Agile/Scrum/SAFe, release management, KPI/OKR governance, quality management, and production deployment. • Strong customer, vendor, partner, and executive stakeholder management capabilities. • Demonstrated ability to drive multiple complex programs while ensuring schedule, cost, quality, technical maturity, and customer commitments.

• Strong architecture review, technical governance, mentoring, decision-making, and executive communication capabilities.

• Strong understanding of Azure/GCP, CI/CD, containerization, orchestration, monitoring, and production AI operations.

**Full Stack Development**

title: Solution architect - Control & Instrumentation
description:
**About the Role**

We are looking for a technically strong Solution Architect to lead Control & Instrumentation estimation and solution development for industrial projects. The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience across the project lifecycle — from field instrumentation and engineering documentation to bid preparation and customer engagement.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop optimum C&I solutions in response to customer RFQs and tender documents.
* Prepare BOQs, instrument index, and cost estimates for C&I projects.
* Design system architecture covering field instrument selection, control system configuration, and BOM preparation using relevant tools.
* Conduct technical assessments to analyze customer process requirements, constraints, and applicable standards.
* Review P&IDs, preliminary data, specifications, and deliverable lists to define scope and estimate contents.
* Conduct site visits and attend pre-bid meetings; resolve technical queries during the tendering/Bidding process.
* Coordinate with instrument OEMs, control system vendors, and subcontractors for pricing; evaluate and compare proposals.
* Prepare and review C&I engineering documents including datasheets, hook-up drawings, loop diagrams, cable schedules, and cause & effect matrices.
* Provide timely technical inputs and estimations to the sales team to support bid closure.
* Deliver technical clarifications and documentation support to customers through the bid phase.

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Instrumentation & Control, Electronics & Instrumentation, or a relevant engineering discipline.
* 4+ years of experience in any combination of C&I estimation, engineering design, or instrument erection and commissioning for industrial projects.
* Hands-on experience with field instrumentation — pressure, flow, level, temperature, and analytical instruments, including selection, sizing, and datasheet preparation.
* Working knowledge of control systems — DCS, PLC, RTU, and SCADA platforms.
* Proficiency in C&I engineering documentation — P&ID interpretation, Instrument Index, Datasheets, Hook-up Drawings, Loop Diagrams, Cable Schedules, and Cause & Effect Charts.
* Familiarity with industrial communication protocols — HART, Modbus RTU/TCP-IP, Profibus/Profinet, and Foundation Fieldbus.
* Understanding of communication networks — Ethernet, Fiber Optics, RS-232/485.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate and position multi-vendor solutions.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills in a cross-functional, customer-facing environment.
* Experience in installation of Field instruments.

**Location: Cochin**

At Consyst, we believe in nurturing talent and fostering a collaborative work environment that promotes growth and innovation. If you are ready to take the next step in your career and make a significant impact in the Industrial Automation field, we encourage you to apply today!

title: Microservices Architect
description:
**Job Description**
 We are seeking an experienced Microservices Architect to perform the role of Engineering Manager, leading the architecture, design, planning, and delivery of large\-scale eCommerce initiatives built on a Java\-based microservices ecosystem. This role combines engineering leadership, solution architecture, and delivery ownership to ensure successful execution of strategic platform modernization and customer experience initiatives.
   

  

 This is a technology\-first, hands\-on engineering leadership role. The successful candidate must remain actively involved in architecture, technical decision\-making, engineering quality, and solution delivery while leading distributed engineering teams.
   

  

**Core Requirements**
* 15\+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 5 years in engineering leadership, architecture, or delivery leadership roles.
* Design distributed data architectures and determine appropriate database strategies across relational, NoSQL, cache, search, and event\-streaming platforms.
* Familiar with observability platforms like Jaeger, Prometheus, Grafana.
* Define microservices architecture, service boundaries, bounded contexts, and domain decomposition using DDD principles.
* Experience with service mesh technologies such as Istio or equivalent.
* Strong hands\-on engineering background in Java and Spring Boot microservices, with the ability to review architecture, designs, APIs, and implementation approaches.
* Experience designing and delivering large\-scale eCommerce or digital\-commerce platforms.
* Deep understanding of REST APIs, distributed systems, integration patterns, event\-driven architecture, and messaging or streaming technologies such as Kafka.
* Strong knowledge of cloud\-native architecture and public cloud platforms, preferably AWS.
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, DevOps, observability, SRE practices, resiliency, and production operations.
* Strong understanding of database technologies, caching strategies, scalability, performance optimization, security, and high\-volume platform readiness.
* Lead technical design reviews and guide teams on scalable, secure, maintainable, resilient, and high\-performing solution designs.
* Collaborate closely with SRE and platform engineering teams to drive observability, reliability, performance optimization, capacity planning, and operational excellence.
* Define and enforce engineering standards, architecture principles, development practices, and technical governance.
* Foster a culture of engineering excellence through continuous improvement, innovation, automation, code quality, technical debt reduction, and adoption of modern engineering practices.
* Mentor engineering leads and senior engineers on architecture, design thinking, engineering best practices, problem solving, and technical decision\-making while supporting their professional growth.
* Champion engineering quality through code reviews, testing strategies, CI/CD practices, release governance, and production readiness assessments.
* Working knowledge of AI and GenAI concepts and their practical application in software development, engineering productivity, personalization, recommendation systems, and customer experience initiatives.

title: Senior MES Delivery Lead
description:
**Job Description**
 The Senior MES Delivery Lead will work closely with Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Automation, IT, Data Backbone teams, and external technology partners to drive MES adoption and support manufacturing transformation initiatives. Responsibilities include process analysis, requirements engineering, workshop facilitation, solution evaluation, architecture collaboration, implementation support, deployment planning, testing, documentation, and continuous improvement activities.
   

  

 The successful candidate will act as a subject matter expert for MES and digital manufacturing systems, helping to define future\-state manufacturing processes, support Smart Factory initiatives, and contribute to the long\-term development of SPS's manufacturing technology landscape. As the program evolves, the role is expected to progress toward ownership of MES strategy, deployment activities, and future capability development within the organization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Lead and support MES implementation, deployment, and scaling activities across SPS manufacturing sites globally.
* Analyse manufacturing processes and identify opportunities for digitalisation, automation, process optimisation, and operational improvements.
* Gather, define, structure, and maintain business, functional, technical, and architectural requirements for MES and related manufacturing systems.
* Develop and maintain manufacturing use cases, business scenarios, process flows, and solution evaluation criteria.
* Facilitate workshops with Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Planning, Automation, IT, and business stakeholders to capture requirements and align solution designs.
* Evaluate MES modules and capabilities against business needs, technology architecture, integration requirements, scalability, and long\-term sustainability objectives.
* Contribute to solution architecture design involving MES, ERP, PLM, SCADA, PLC, Historian, APS, and related manufacturing systems.
* Support integration planning and coordination between enterprise platforms and manufacturing systems to ensure effective information flow across the manufacturing environment.
* Participate in system testing, validation activities, deployment planning, issue resolution, and implementation support throughout project lifecycles.
* Collaborate closely with Smart Factory, Data Backbone, Automation, Quality, Engineering, Operations, IT teams, and external technology vendors.
* Prepare documentation including requirements specifications, process maps, evaluation reports, implementation plans, testing documentation, and deployment materials.
* Support decision\-making processes through technical analysis, solution recommendations, and business case development.
* Promote best practices in digital manufacturing, Industry 4\.0, Smart Factory solutions, and manufacturing system governance.
* Take ownership of assigned initiatives and drive activities through completion while effectively communicating progress, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Contribute to the development of future MES capabilities and support the growth of SPS's digital manufacturing competency.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Automation Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Master's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing Systems, Industrial Automation, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), manufacturing systems, industrial digitalisation, Smart Factory initiatives, or related disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience leading or supporting end\-to\-end MES implementation, deployment, and rollout projects within manufacturing environments.
* Strong understanding of MES integration with ERP, PLC, SCADA, Historian, APS, PLM, Quality Management Systems, and related manufacturing technologies.
* Experience conducting manufacturing process mapping, business analysis, requirements gathering, workshop facilitation, and solution evaluation activities.
* Good understanding of enterprise architecture and manufacturing system architecture principles.
* Ability to work effectively across Operations, Engineering, Quality, IT, and business stakeholder groups.
* Experience working within manufacturing environments and a strong understanding of shopfloor operations and production processes.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, documentation, and communication skills.
* Experience with MES platforms such as AVEVA, Critical Manufacturing, Siemens Opcenter, Rockwell FactoryTalk, Proficy, or similar solutions is preferred.
* Experience supporting global or multi\-site manufacturing deployments is highly desirable.
* Exposure to Industry 4\.0, Industrial Data Backbone, Unified Namespace (UNS), MQTT, Industrial Historian platforms, or related technologies is advantageous.
* Experience within engineer\-to\-order, project\-based, high\-mix, batch, continuous, or other complex manufacturing environments is preferred.
* Demonstrates ownership, leadership, and a proactive approach to driving initiatives, managing stakeholders, and delivering business outcomes.
* Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively in international and cross\-functional teams.
* Willingness to travel internationally, including visits to Denmark, Brazil, the UK, and other SPS manufacturing locations as required.


**About Us**
 Every day, the oil and gas industry’s best minds put more than 150 years of experience to work to help our customers achieve lasting success.
   

  

**We Power the Industry that Powers the World**
 Throughout every region in the world and across every area of drilling and production, our family of companies has provided the technical expertise, advanced equipment, and operational support necessary for success—now and in the future.
   

  

**Global Family**
 We are a global family of thousands of individuals, working as one team to create a lasting impact for ourselves, our customers, and the communities where we live and work.
   

  

**Purposeful Innovation**
 Through purposeful business innovation, product creation, and service delivery, we are driven to power the industry that powers the world better.
   

  

**Service Above All**
 This drives us to anticipate our customers’ needs and work with them to deliver the finest products and services on time and on budget.

 **SAP BODS Manager**

 . The role requires a strong blend of

* Lead end‑to‑end SAP data migration workstreams using SAP BODS

* Collaborate with functional leads, architects, and cross‑track teams

+ Migration design documents
+ BODS architecture and job designs
+ Data validation and reconciliation strategies

* Proactively identify migration risks and define mitigation plans

+ Solutioning

+ SAP BODS architecture, design, and performance optimization

+ SAP source and target systems

+ Migration strategies
+ Technical architectures

title: Director of Engineering
description:
**About the Role** 




  





 We are seeking an experienced and results\-driven Director of Engineering to lead our software engineering organization in Kochi. This individual will be responsible for managing engineering managers, technical leads, architects, and software development teams while driving execution, delivery, engineering excellence, and continuous innovation across multiple SaaS products.
 



  





 The ideal candidate is an experienced technology leader with a strong software engineering background, exceptional people management skills, and a proven track record of delivering enterprise SaaS platforms at scale.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Lead and manage multiple software engineering teams across product development, architecture, QA, DevOps, and engineering operations.



  




* Build, mentor, and develop Engineering Managers, Technical Leads, Architects, and senior engineers.



  




* Drive engineering strategy aligned with business objectives and product roadmap.



  




* Ensure timely delivery of high\-quality software releases.



  




* Establish engineering best practices, coding standards, CI/CD processes, and quality metrics.



  




* Partner closely with Product Management, Design, Customer Success, Security, and Executive Leadership.



  




* Drive technical architecture decisions and long\-term platform scalability.



  




* Improve engineering productivity, release velocity, system reliability, and operational excellence.



  




* Develop succession plans and career growth opportunities for engineering talent.



  




* Lead hiring efforts and build high\-performing engineering teams.



  




* Manage engineering capacity planning, resource allocation, and project prioritization.



  




* Monitor engineering KPIs including sprint velocity, delivery timelines, quality metrics, technical debt, uptime, and customer\-impacting issues.



  




* Foster a culture of accountability, ownership, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.



  




* Drive Agile development methodologies across multiple Scrum teams.



  




* Identify technology risks and proactively develop mitigation strategies.



  




* Support executive leadership with engineering planning, forecasting, and strategic initiatives.



  





**Required Qualifications** 




  




* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.



  




* 12\+ years of software engineering experience.



  




* 5\+ years leading large engineering organizations.



  




* Experience managing Engineering Managers and cross\-functional engineering teams.



  




* Proven experience delivering enterprise SaaS applications.



  




* Strong understanding of distributed systems, cloud architecture, APIs, microservices, and scalable software design.



  




* Experience with Agile/Scrum development methodologies.



  




* Excellent leadership, communication, coaching, and organizational skills.



  




* Experience working with globally distributed engineering teams.



  




* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.



  




* Ability to balance technical excellence with business priorities.



  




* Experience in healthcare technology or regulated SaaS environments.



  




* Experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.



  




* Knowledge of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure automation.



  




* Experience leading digital transformation or engineering modernization initiatives.



  




* Familiarity with AI\-assisted development tools and engineering productivity platforms.



  





**Leadership Expectations** 




  





 Lead by example through accountability, integrity, and execution.
 



  





 Build a high\-performance engineering culture focused on quality and continuous improvement.
 



  





 Coach and mentor future engineering leaders.
 



  





 Encourage innovation while maintaining operational discipline.
 



  





 Make data\-driven decisions and communicate effectively across all organizational levels.
 



  





 Promote collaboration between engineering and business stakeholders.
 



  





**What We're Looking For** 




  





 Strategic thinker with strong execution capabilities.
 



  





 Exceptional people leader with experience scaling engineering organizations.
 



  





 Passion for building enterprise\-grade SaaS products.
 



  





 Strong decision\-maker who thrives in fast\-paced environments.
 



  





 Hands\-on enough to understand technical challenges while leading at a strategic level.
 



  





 Committed to developing talent and fostering a culture of ownership and excellence.

Our end\-to\-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen \& Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass \& Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North \& South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.
 



  





 Cyncly offers over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end\-to\-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world\-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.
 



  





 Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specializing in technology
 



  





**About the Role** 




  





 Cyncly is establishing a dedicated AI Centre of Excellence (AI CoE) in Kochi, India, to build, fine\-tune, and operationalize on\-premises large language models across Cyncly's product suite. The AI/ML Engineer is a hands\-on technical role responsible for training pipelines, fine\-tuning domain\-specific models, embeddings infrastructure, and integrating AI across five LLM use cases: product knowledge search, document intelligence, Service Desk ticket classification and resolution drafting, developer copilot assistance, and conversational product configuration.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**LLM Fine\-Tuning \& Training Pipelines** 




  




* Implement and maintain supervised fine\-tuning (SFT) and RLHF pipelines for Cyncly domain\-specific models, leveraging proprietary product catalogue, documentation, and support data.
* Apply LoRA/QLoRA fine\-tuning via Hugging Face PEFT; manage model checkpointing, hyperparameter tuning, and training run tracking. Work with quantised models (GGUF, AWQ, GPTQ) to optimise inference on GPU.
* Maintain reproducible experiments, model versioning, and artefact management using MLflow or Weights \& Biases; collaborate with Data Engineering to curate and version domain datasets with PII scrubbing and data\-quality checks.



  





**Embeddings Infrastructure \& Semantic Search** 




  




* Develop and optimise embedding pipelines using models such as BGE\-M3 and E5\-large; manage vector database ingestion, indexing strategies, and retrieval quality for Cyncly's product catalogues and documentation.
* Design, benchmark, and maintain vector database deployments (Qdrant, Weaviate, or equivalent), including index configuration, filtering strategies, and scalability planning.
* Implement retrieval quality metrics (MRR, NDCG, recall@k), run A/B evaluations of embedding model upgrades, and build hybrid search pipelines combining dense vector retrieval with BM25 sparse search to maximise product discovery accuracy.



  





**RAG Architecture \& Use Case Integration** 




  




* Design and implement RAG layers for Cyncly's five LLM use cases, ensuring context relevance, faithfulness, and latency targets; integrate MCP connectors to expose internal data sources and product APIs to the LLM inference layer.
* Build and maintain the developer copilot integration using Continue.dev and custom language\-server extensions; implement prompt injection defenses, output filtering, and guardrail layers across all inference paths.
* Work closely with Product and Engineering squads to expose AI capabilities through REST/OpenAI\-compatible APIs and integrate them into Cyncly's product surfaces.



  





**Model Evaluation \& Quality Assurance** 




  




* Write model evaluation harnesses and regression test suites; track and report quality metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, faithfulness score, hallucination rate, answer relevance) per deployed model and use case.
* Partner with the AI/ML QA team to design human evaluation workflows and validate model outputs before production release; maintain a model leaderboard and evaluation artefacts for all active models enabling data\-driven decisions on upgrades and rollbacks.
* Implement continuous evaluation pipelines triggered on model updates, ensuring quality regressions are detected before reaching production.



  





**Inference Infrastructure \& Observability** 




  




* Deploy and manage LLM inference using vLLM or Text Generation Inference (TGI) on Cyncly's on\-premises GPU infrastructure, targeting production\-grade throughput and latency SLAs.
* Instrument inference latency, throughput (tokens/sec), GPU utilisation, and cost metrics; surface results to operational dashboards for the AI leadership team; participate in on\-call rotation and incident response for model\-serving issues.
* Contribute to the containerisation and orchestration of AI workloads using Docker and Kubernetes, ensuring deployments are reproducible, scalable, and integrated with Cyncly's CI/CD pipelines.



  





**Knowledge Graphs \& Advanced Data Pipelines** 




  




* Contribute to Cyncly's product knowledge graph (Neo4j) — entity\-extraction pipelines, schema design, and graph query integration with RAG; build NLP pipelines to enrich product and document knowledge.
* Explore and prototype agentic AI patterns (tool use, multi\-step reasoning) for complex information retrieval and action execution use cases.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or equivalent practical experience.
* 5–8 years of hands\-on software and/or AI/ML engineering experience, with at least 2 years working directly with large language models or transformer\-based systems.
* Strong Python programming skills; proficiency with PyTorch or JAX training ecosystems, and Hugging Face Transformers, PEFT (LoRA, QLoRA), and model evaluation frameworks.
* Working knowledge of at least one vector database (Qdrant, Weaviate, Pinecone, Chroma, or equivalent), including indexing, filtering, and retrieval optimisation; solid understanding of embedding models, semantic search quality metrics, and RAG architecture patterns.
* Experience building and consuming REST/OpenAI\-compatible APIs; solid understanding of prompt engineering best practices including few\-shot prompting, chain\-of\-thought, and structured outputs.
* Familiarity with containerisation (Docker) and orchestration (Kubernetes), and experience working within CI/CD pipelines.



  





**Mandatory Technical Experience** 




  




* **LLM Frameworks:** 
 Proficiency in Python with the Hugging Face ecosystem (Transformers, Datasets, PEFT, Accelerate, Evaluate).
* **Fine\-Tuning \& Quantisation:** 
 Experience with LoRA, QLoRA, and quantisation techniques (GGUF, AWQ, GPTQ) for on\-premises model deployment.
* **Inference Serving:** 
 Hands\-on experience with vLLM, Text Generation Inference (TGI), or Ollama for production LLM serving.
* **Vector Databases \& RAG:** 
 Practical experience designing and querying vector databases; proficiency in retrieval evaluation and hybrid search implementations.
* **Experiment Tracking \& Evaluation:** 
 MLflow, Weights \& Biases, or LangSmith for experiment tracking and LLM observability; strong background in model evaluation — automated metrics (BLEU, ROUGE, RAGAS), human evaluation, and regression testing.
* **Infrastructure \& DevOps:** 
 Experience with Docker and Kubernetes; ability to write Dockerfiles, Helm charts, and CI/CD pipeline configurations.



  





**Preferred / Nice\-to\-Have** 




  




* Exposure to knowledge graphs (Neo4j, Cypher/SPARQL) for entity extraction and graph\-augmented retrieval; experience integrating helpdesk or ticketing platforms (e.g. Zendesk APIs) for NLP\-driven classification and resolution drafting.
* Familiarity with agentic AI frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen) or MCP connector development; experience with developer tooling integrations such as Continue.dev, GitHub Copilot extensions, or custom LSP implementations.
* Open\-source contributions to ML projects, LLM tooling, or evaluation frameworks; experience with multi\-modal or vision\-language models (VLMs) for product image understanding.



  





**Competency Requirements** 




  




* **Engineering Excellence:** 
 Writes clean, well\-tested Python code; comfortable with code reviews, Git workflows, and contributing to shared ML infrastructure libraries.
* **Analytical \& Experimental Mindset:** 
 Designs experiments with clear hypotheses, tracks results rigorously, and uses evaluation data to make evidence\-based model decisions.
* **Collaboration \& Communication:** 
 Works effectively with Data Engineers, QA, Product, and Platform teams; communicates ML concepts clearly to non\-specialist stakeholders.
* **Ownership \& Initiative:** 
 Able to take ownership of a workstream, manage ambiguity in early\-stage AI projects, and deliver iterative results in a fast\-moving AI programme.



  





**Working for us:** 




 At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills \- and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.
 



  





 Here, you’ll join a group of colleagues who take ownership, solve problems, and focus on making an impact. We embrace curiosity, welcome new ideas, and see mistakes as opportunities to learn. You’ll have the freedom to work flexibly and autonomously, supported by teammates and leaders who are committed to your growth.
 



  





 We celebrate the different ways people contribute and encourage everyone \- from every background \- to bring their authentic self to work. Because when we collaborate, challenge each other, and share what we know, we build something better together.
 



  





 If you want to work in a place where your ideas matter, your growth is valued, and your work shapes the spaces people live, work, and play in \- come join us.

 The Senior OT/IT Data Specialist will support the design, implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of the Smart Factory Data Backbone platform. This role bridges industrial automation, OT/IT networking, industrial data engineering, and modern software platforms. The successful candidate will support integration of shop\-floor equipment and OT systems with edge, enterprise IT, and cloud services while ensuring industrial data is secure, reliable, well\-governed, and fit for downstream applications.
   

  

 This is a senior, hands\-on technical role that combines architecture support, technical delivery, platform troubleshooting, vendor coordination, stakeholder collaboration, data governance, and operational support across manufacturing locations. The role will work closely with architects, engineers, lifecycle teams, system integrators, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable smart factory solutions and support future digital manufacturing initiatives.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Participate in site\-level architecture design activities across manufacturing locations and support implementation of the Smart Factory Data Backbone platform.
* Install, configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Data Backbone infrastructure, including Kubernetes/OpenShift\-based edge deployments.
* Integrate industrial equipment, PLCs, and OT systems using industrial protocols such as Siemens S7, OPC UA, MQTT, and similar connectivity technologies.
* Troubleshoot OT/IT networking issues including TCP/IP, routing, NAT, firewalls, DNS, certificates, and edge\-to\-cloud connectivity.
* Build, support, and maintain industrial data pipelines, messaging solutions, and integration architectures using technologies such as Litmus, MQTT, and OPC UA.
* Develop and maintain industrial data models to contextualize machine, asset, and time\-series data for downstream applications and analytics.
* Perform data validation and troubleshooting across the complete machine\-to\-cloud data flow, including equipment, network, edge platform, data pipeline, and database/cloud environments to ensure data quality, accuracy, and reliability.
* Support technical acceptance testing of vendor solutions following deployment and contribute to Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) activities.
* Support IT/OT risk assessments related to the Smart Factory Data Backbone platform and connected manufacturing systems.
* Contribute to the development and maintenance of data governance standards, documentation, tag naming conventions, and tag enablement processes.
* Produce and maintain technical documentation including system designs, technical procedures, configuration guides, governance documentation, and operational support materials.
* Collaborate closely with architects, lifecycle teams, software developers, data engineers, system integrators, vendors, and manufacturing stakeholders to support successful project delivery.
* Support system enhancements, upgrades, troubleshooting activities, and continuous improvement initiatives for industrial data platforms and connected systems.
* Transfer technical knowledge to lifecycle teams, contractors, vendors, developers, and support personnel to ensure sustainable long\-term platform ownership.
* Take ownership of assigned technical activities and proactively drive issues to resolution while effectively communicating progress, risks, and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with company procedures, quality standards, cybersecurity requirements, and engineering governance practices.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in information technology, Data Science, Automation, Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Engineering Technology, or a related discipline.
* Master's degree in a relevant technical discipline is preferred.
* Minimum 7 years of relevant professional experience supporting one or more of the following areas:
* OT/IT convergence
* Industrial automation
* IIoT and Smart Factory platforms
* Industrial data engineering
* Industrial IT
* Platform engineering
* Systems engineering
* Strong experience with industrial protocols and connectivity technologies such as OPC UA, MQTT, Siemens S7, or equivalent industrial communication protocols.
* Strong understanding of OT/IT networking concepts, including TCP/IP, routing, NAT, firewalls, DNS, certificates, and secure connectivity.
* Experience designing, implementing, or supporting industrial data pipelines, messaging platforms, and integration architectures.
* Experience working with industrial Historians, time\-series databases, or similar industrial data platforms.
* Experience with Kubernetes, OpenShift, Docker, or other containerized deployment technologies.
* Experience with Litmus or equivalent industrial edge platforms is preferred.
* Experience with AVEVA Historian, QuestDB, PI System, Ignition Historian, or equivalent Historian/time\-series database platforms is desirable.
* Experience with tag enablement, Historian/SCADA tag scaling, and configuration activities is preferred.
* Experience with Unified Namespace (UNS) architectures and industrial data contextualization is desirable.
* Experience working in multi\-site manufacturing, industrial, process industry, energy, oil and gas, utilities, or brownfield operational environments is advantageous.
* Familiarity with industrial cybersecurity practices and standards such as IEC 62443\.
* Experience supporting production platforms, operational support teams, and lifecycle management activities.
* Experience collaborating with external technology vendors, system integrators, and third\-party service providers.
* Ability to develop and maintain solutions using Python, Go, TypeScript, Node\-RED, or similar technologies.
* Experience with modern software development and operational practices including SLAs, change management, incident management, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across OT, IT, engineering, and business teams.
* Demonstrates ownership by taking responsibility for issues, following through on actions, and driving tasks to completion.
* Shows initiative, adaptability, and a proactive attitude while working across organizational and geographical boundaries.
* Produces accurate, maintainable, and well\-documented technical solutions while maintaining high standards of quality and reliability.

title: Engineering Head
description:
Difinity Digital is a Data and AI consulting firm delivering solutions across artificial intelligence, data and analytics, and digital engineering for clients in the UAE and Europe, alongside a portfolio of proprietary products.
 



 The Engineering Head holds complete ownership of the engineering function. The role carries accountability for technical strategy, delivery governance, engineering capability and organisational structure, in addition to the architecture and quality of every solution the company builds and deploys.
 



 The position combines functional leadership with continued technical depth. The Engineering Head is expected to set direction, build the team and govern delivery, while remaining sufficiently hands\-on in architecture and technical review to hold authority over engineering decisions.
 



  





**EXPERIENCE: 10\+ years** 




  





**2\. Key Responsibilities** 




**Engineering Strategy and Function Ownership** 



1. Define the technical strategy for the engineering function across AI, data and analytics, and product engineering.
2. Establish the technology roadmap, platform standards and architectural principles adopted across the organisation.
3. Build and maintain the engineering capability plan, including skill development, team structure and workforce planning.
4. Manage relationships with technology partners and platform vendors and evaluate new tooling and platforms for adoption.
5. Own engineering budgets, tooling investment and infrastructure cost governance.



  





**Delivery Governance** 



1. Hold accountability for technical delivery across all client engagements and internal product development.
2. Establish delivery methodology, engineering standards, quality gates and release governance.
3. Oversee resource allocation, utilisation and capacity planning across concurrent engagements.
4. Monitor delivery health, manage technical and schedule risk, and own resolution of technical escalations.
5. Report engineering performance, risk and capacity to the Director.



  





**Solution Architecture and Technical Requirements** 



1. Own solution architecture and data architecture standards across the organisation.
2. Approve the technical approach, feasibility position and effort estimation for new engagements.
3. Contribute directly to architecture design for complex, high\-risk or strategically significant engagements.
4. Review and approve the technical content of client proposals and statements of work.



  





**Technical Quality and Governance** 



1. Define and enforce code review, design review and security review standards.
2. Maintain final approval authority on architecture decisions and technical debt trade\-offs.
3. Drive the development of reusable frameworks, accelerators and reference implementations.



  





**Organisational and People Leadership** 



1. Lead, structure and scale the engineering organisation across all technical disciplines.
2. Own technical hiring, including role definition, assessment frameworks and interview panels.
3. Establish performance management, career progression paths and technical competency frameworks.
4. Mentor senior engineers and develop the next layer of technical leadership.



  





**Deployment, Security and Compliance** 



1. Ensure all solutions are deployed securely with appropriate access controls, data privacy measures and regulatory compliance.
2. Define governance for AI systems including model evaluation, guardrails, monitoring, failure handling and cost control.
3. Own production readiness criteria and post\-deployment support standards.



  





**Client and Commercial Engagement** 



1. Represent the engineering function in client engagements requiring senior technical authority, including solution workshops, architecture presentations and escalation management.
2. Support pre\-sales through technical validation, solution design and credibility in client\-facing technical discussions.



  





**3\. Skills and Experience** 




 Candidates are assessed on demonstrated capability and delivery track record rather than years of experience. Depth in every discipline is not expected.
 


1. Proven ownership of engineering delivery for a team or function, with accountability for architecture and quality outcomes.
2. Track record of taking production systems from requirement through to live deployment and ongoing support.
3. Strong, demonstrable expertise in at least one of the following areas: artificial intelligence, data and analytics, or product engineering.
4. Applied experience in artificial intelligence covering machine learning, computer vision or natural language processing, and generative AI including large language model applications and retrieval augmented generation.
5. Applied experience in data and analytics covering data engineering, pipeline design, warehouse or lakehouse architecture, data modelling, governance, and business intelligence.
6. Applied experience in product engineering covering application and product engineering, API and backend service design, enterprise system integration, cloud infrastructure and DevOps.
7. Sufficient working knowledge of the disciplines outside the primary area of expertise to conduct architecture review, validate estimates, assess technical risk and assess technical candidates.
8. Working knowledge of cloud deployment practice, CI/CD, security, access control and data privacy.
9. Understanding of AI governance including model evaluation, guardrails, monitoring and cost control.
10. Experience building, structuring and developing engineering teams.
11. Delivery experience in a consulting, professional services or client\-facing product environment.
12. Ability to present and defend technical positions to executive, client and engineering audiences.
13. Experience in offshore delivery models serving international clients is desirable.
14. Commercial understanding of utilisation, margin and estimation discipline in a services business is desirable.
15. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology or a related discipline. Postgraduate qualification desirable.

description:
Kochi \| Bangalore
   

  

 Apply for this job
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Job Description**
* Configure and maintain CDP data models, audience/segment definitions, and identity resolution.
* Build and maintain CDP integrations with Databricks/Delta Lake (zero\-copy access patterns).
* Design and maintain event streaming integration using AWS MSK (Kafka), including external publishing.
* Build, configure, and maintain destination connectors to Adobe Campaign Classic (email), Airship (push), and Infobip (SMS).
* Build and support journeys/orchestration logic, including governance and suppression across overlapping member experiences.
* Support integration work for experimentation/personalization layers (e.g., Optimizely, Bloomreach) consuming CDP\-supplied segmentation.
* Build ingestion pipelines for engagement feedback loops (delivery/engagement events flowing back into Databricks).
* Scope and deliver platform enhancements as new use cases, channels, audiences, or business requirements emerge.
* Partner with product/marketing stakeholders to translate business requirements into CDP configuration and logic.
* Triage, troubleshoot, and resolve platform issues raised by business/marketing stakeholders (e.g., segment/audience errors, sync failures, journey/campaign delivery issues, data discrepancies).
* Perform root\-cause analysis on production issues and implement fixes or workarounds.
* Monitor platform health (sync jobs, journey runs, data freshness, audience counts) and proactively flag/address problems.
* Maintain documentation for platform configuration, data flows, API contracts, and known issues/resolutions.
* Participate in vendor working sessions to define technical requirements and surface product gaps.


**Required Skills**
* 5\+ years working directly in/on a CDP or similar MarTech data platform (configuration, activation, and support)
* Hands\-on experience with audience/segment building, identity resolution, and journey/orchestration tooling
* Strong Databricks and Delta Lake experience (Unity Catalog, data\-sharing connectivity)
* AWS experience, particularly MSK/Kafka.
* REST API integration experience with marketing execution platforms (ESP, push, SMS providers)
* Adobe Campaign Classic experience \- hands\-on with workflows, campaign/journey setup, and API\-based integration
* API\-first, composable architecture / connector\-based integration experience
* Experience implementing/maintaining a CDP Web SDK or similar client\-side event tracking SDK (JavaScript) for behavioral/event data capture
* Strong troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis skills; comfortable being a hands\-on point of contact for business\-reported issues
* Strong technical skills


 Support CDP (Customer Data Platform) as part of the Personalization Program covering platform configuration, audience/segmentation build, journey/orchestration support, integrations, enhancements, and ongoing production support. This is a broad CDP role, not limited to integration work, it includes building and maintaining segments, campaigns/journeys, governance and suppression logic, and troubleshooting issues across the platform end\-to\-end.

description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**IT Network \& Infrastructure Security – Senior Manager**
**Role Summary**
 We are looking for a Senior Manager to lead and scale the Zero Trust Security Portfolio across EY GDS. This role will be responsible for leading complex client programs, building high\-performing teams, and driving innovation across Infrastructure Security capabilities.
   

  

 The Senior Manager will act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders and internal leadership, helping organizations transition from traditional security to Zero Trust Security. The role requires deep experience in cybersecurity architecture, network security, and zero trust security in cyber.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the design and implementation of network and infrastructure security strategies across enterprise \& cloud environments.
* Drive adoption of Zero Trust and advanced segmentation architectures.
* Oversee deployment and governance of NGFW, NAC, VPN, ZTNA, SASE, DNS security, CASB, and CSPM solutions.
* Experience in Zero Trust Security Architecture and Solution Design.
* Experience in zero\-trust and micro\-segmentation solutions including Zscaler, Guardicore and Illumio.
* Define logical patterns \& develop use cases for zero trust capabilities across Network, Identity \& Access Management, Device, Application and other security domains
* Work in multiple domains of security technologies viz Network segmentation, Application gateways, security automation, Firewalls, VPN, SDN, SD\-WAN, IAM solutions.
* Possess hands on experience in segmenting networks, applications, and data to limit exposure to attacks.
* Good exposure in requirement understanding, security frameworks, technical documentation, designing HLDs and LLDs.
* Well\-versed in encrypting all end\-to\-end communication regardless of the location, authorizing access to resources on a per\-session basis, enforcing the temporary and dynamic nature of authentication and authorization.
* Monitoring all assets to be in the most secure state possible and maintaining visibility into the security of the entire network and business's resources.
* Demonstrate a deep understanding of zero trust market needs/challenges and assist in the planning, design and development of go\-to\-market solutions.
* Understand SaaS based technologies and identity\-based micro\-segmentation for cloud workloads and their implications for the enterprise.
* Document or enhance documentation on zero\-trust architecture requirements.
* Build reusable methods, accelerators, reference architectures, and runbooks that strengthen the firm’s Zero Trust, Network \& Infrastructure Security offerings and improve repeatability across sectors and accounts.
* Manage client expectations, delivery scope, solution quality, risks, and technical escalations while coaching teams and enabling long\-term client capability through documentation and knowledge transfer.


**Required Qualifications**
* 12\+ years of experience across Network \& Infrastructure security domain, Zero Trust Security, or related fields.
* Expertise in Zero Trust, and regulatory frameworks (NIST 800\-207, NIST 800\-53, ZT DoD, CISA ZTMM).
* Hands\-on with NGFWs (Palo Alto, Cisco, Fortinet, Azure Firewall) and VMware virtualization security.
* Skilled in SSE/SASE platforms (Netskope, Zscaler, Akamai) and secure access technologies (VPN, ZTNA, DNS security).
* Strong capability in multi\-vendor security integration across IT, OT, and cloud environments.
* Strong client\-facing communication and the ability to operate as a trusted technical advisor to senior stakeholders.
* Deep technical understanding of zero trust architecture and solutioning of zero trust security components.
* Deep knowledge of services and service delivery approach and methodology for zero trust security including governance and operating models.
* Clearly demonstrates proven extensive abilities with leveraging creative thinking and problem\-solving skills, individual initiative, and utilizing Office 365, MS Office (Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint) and Google Docs.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Good soft skills i.e. verbal \& written communication, technical document writing etc
* Strong project management, negotiation and interpersonal skills
* Prior experience working in Advisory or Technology Consulting industry
* Customer orientation skills
* Engage with CISOs, CIOs, plant leadership, OT operations teams, technology leaders, and business stakeholders.
* Industry related certification (e.g. CISSP, CISA, CISM, SABSA, PRINCE2, TOGAF)
* Vendor related certifications (e.g. Zscaler, Netskope, Palo Alto Networks, Cisco \& others)


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you
